question: Should this protected prototype branch be preserved for restacking, or replaced by a new diagnostics PR after the Claws RFC contract is accepted?
rationale: The live RFC rejects the current stack as the compatibility contract, so a mechanical patch cannot determine whether this branch should remain the implementation vehicle.

options.title: Restack after RFC
options.body: Preserve the diagnostic requirements and rebuild them on the accepted lifecycle model with read-only state access.

options.title: Sponsor the prototype
options.body: Explicitly adopt the current stack and require migration, upgrade, and no-mutation proof before merge.

options.title: Replace with a narrow PR
options.body: Close this branch later and recreate diagnostics after canonical prerequisite layers land.

recommendation.title: Restack after RFC
recommendation.body: Preserve the diagnostic requirements and rebuild them on the accepted lifecycle model with read-only state access.

likelyOwner.reason: The current state-diagnostics provenance and protected core product scope make this the strongest available routing candidate.
